PR83's existing native evidence leaves reference sensitivity and cancellation-dependent component orders unresolved. This follow-up makes the next bounded experiment executable while preserving the C21F kernel, fixtures, old raw evidence and previous publication history.

## Changes

- Extend only the existing optical-depth reference source with scalar/vector tolerances, exact Y=0 reduction of tolerance entries, a configurable cell step cap, actual RHS counters and accepted-grid hashes.
- Add a fixed plan: two existing fixtures × L1/L2/L3/L3M (8 new references), then native_source FULLMID/MIDPHOTO_ENDMICRO at n=128/256 (4 new histories) only after all reference executions complete and the native pilot resolution is ready.
- Add independent photon/log/EOS/ledger diagnostics, signed and reference-free orders, and reference-free two-scale coefficient diagnostics. Empirical reference differences are not global error bounds.
- Bind source/fixture/manifest/runtime/binary identities to complete, create-only job receipts. Preserve failed outputs and clean only owned process groups on timeout.
- Include the derivation, SciPy/primary-paper and SciSpace/Exa/Wolfram intake, fresh backup delta, scoped independent review, DAG and copyable NCP handoff.

## Validation actually performed here

- Reference controls: 9 focused tests PASS.
- Independent diagnostics: 9 focused tests PASS.
- Orchestration/reuse/source drift: 14 focused tests PASS.
- Standalone analysis external anchors: 3 focused tests PASS.
- Exact manufactured IVPs: 9 cases PASS, 1.9097576 s; the analytic formula is evaluated in binary64.
- Plan/input identity PASS; 3 manufactured wiring jobs PASS, 4.494275 s.
- Old C21F 56-test suite, native matrix and full raw audit were reused rather than rerun. Tests are not all claimed red-first.

## Execution boundary

New C21G native jobs: **NOT_RUN**. Fresh remote quota was 0%; current NCP CPU/RAM/campaign availability is **UNVERIFIED_CURRENT_NCP**. NCP needs current inventory, one allocated CPU other than protected CPU55, a verified existing native binary or the unchanged pinned-owner build script, and bounded execution. Full48, source-age/spectral/angular, Case B, signed Bianchi, full EoR and standalone Grackle driver parity remain HOLD. `global_error_bound=null`.

C21G executable content commit: `e742d44f605c51c06615451774ba90af8f41f622`.
Parent assessment head: `d780c2c53f869c914add1d5492312d0bc507f976`.
C21F baseline execution: `f8359232df8d0dd4fe91fcdabeb6701eb06089ba`.

## Delivery completed

Publication and three-provider create-only backup acknowledgements are now in [PUBLICATION_RECEIPT.json](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/bass_cr/blob/bf7f7abbe5d2b1844a8fb90bd7e48df23dc5a0c5/research/cr_c21g_reference_refinement_20261019/PUBLICATION_RECEIPT.json), [BACKUP_RECEIPT.json](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/bass_cr/blob/bf7f7abbe5d2b1844a8fb90bd7e48df23dc5a0c5/research/cr_c21g_reference_refinement_20261019/BACKUP_RECEIPT.json) and [DAG_C21G.json](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/bass_cr/blob/bf7f7abbe5d2b1844a8fb90bd7e48df23dc5a0c5/research/cr_c21g_reference_refinement_20261019/DAG_C21G.json).
